port.description: TCP port the S3 API listens on. When exposed with network.ports[].expose: EXPOSE_VIP, keep it different from the exposed port (3900) and set it as target_port

rpcPort.description: Garage's internal RPC port, bound to localhost; differ per instance on one node

adminPort.description: Garage's admin API port, bound to localhost; differ per instance on one node

region.description: Region name clients sign requests for

accessKeyId.description: Access key id clients use: GK followed by 24 lowercase hex digits (e.g. GK$(openssl rand -hex 12))

secretAccessKey.description: Secret for accessKeyId: 64 lowercase hex digits (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32). Fixed once the key exists on the volume

buckets.description: Buckets to create and grant to the key; the key may also create its own
